chapters.title: Contract
chapters.text: Import and bake are pure authoring. Runtime only consumes Blob Asset Reference Graph Data. Graph Authoring or Graph Authoring Buffer reference Grove Auth Graph, never the source my graph file.

chapters.title: Pipeline
chapters.text: Source GroveGraph is imported by GroveImporter into GroveAuthGraph plus node subassets. GraphAuthoring references the auth main object. GraphBakingSystem calls Auth.Create to emit GraphData. Runtime IGraphReference holds only the blob.

chapters.title: Entry
chapters.text: Report Root Candidate Errors fires if multiple Input to execution roots exist, or if top-level execution exists with no Input root. Untyped Graph Toolkit variables never become runtime Inputs or Outputs.

chapters.title: Hash and strip
chapters.text: Bake hash includes graph identity, selected variant values, instance overrides, and Version Key. Grove Variant Auth Register Stripped Nodes removes unselected branches from the blob.

nodes.user: Author intent. Creates Grove Graph asset.
nodes.chat: GroveGraph source asset (.mygraph). Editor only. Not the baker input.
nodes.planner: GroveImporter ScriptedImporter. Creates auth subassets and sets Root from Input boundary candidates.
nodes.router: GroveAuthGraph: ScriptableObject main asset produced by GroveImporter. Fields Root, Inputs, Outputs, Nodes. GraphAuthoring references this asset. GroveAuthGraph.Create builds BlobAssetReference of GraphData.
nodes.approval: CollectRootCandidates: exactly one Input variable resolving to GroveExecutionAuth.
nodes.blocked: Import validation failure for entry shape.
nodes.retry: Reimport after fixing Input to execution wiring.
nodes.tool: GraphAuthoring of TAuth comma TComponent. References Auth, registers bake deps, writes GraphBakingData.
nodes.external: GraphBakingSystem. Calls Auth.Create with instance values and variant selection.
nodes.store: Dictionary of Grove Variant Auth to selected branch.
nodes.trace: Instance values and Grove State initialize bake.
nodes.final: I Graph Reference Graph property holds the blob.
